summary_en: Akatsuki completed tender offer for Sunnyside-up Group (TSE Standard, code 2180) common shares at ¥1,320/share. Tendered shares: 9,461,236 (63.8% of shares ex-treasury and NF's non-tendering stake); total consideration ¥12,488 million. Offer period 2026-05-14 to 2026-06-24. Target becomes Akatsuki consolidated subsidiary effective 2026-07-01 (settlement date).
title_en: Notice Regarding Results of Tender Offer for Shares and Warrants of Sunnyside-up Group Inc. in Connection with Management Integration and Change in Subsidiaries (Change in Specified Subsidiaries)
translation_en_brief:
Akatsuki Inc. announced completion of a tender offer for Sunnyside-up Group Inc. (TSE Standard market, code 2180) shares and warrants as part of a management integration transaction. The offer ran from 2026-05-14 to 2026-06-24 at ¥1,320 per ordinary share and ¥65,900 per warrant.

Results: 9,461,236 ordinary shares were tendered and accepted (representing 63.8% of Sunnyside-up shares outstanding excluding treasury and NF's non-tendering stake of 4,322,880 shares held by Tsuguhara Etsuko, the company's representative director through asset management company NextField). Total consideration: ¥12,488 million. The minimum acceptance threshold (5,551,400 shares) was exceeded, permitting full purchase of all tendered securities.

Effective 2026-07-01 (settlement date), Sunnyside-up Group will become a consolidated subsidiary of Akatsuki and a specified subsidiary. The offer also targeted 106,100 shares underlying new warrants issued 2023-06-16 (exercise period 2026-10-01 to 2029-09-30).
